punchline: In the large organizations Gallup surveyed, only 20 percent of employees strongly agreed they get to do what they do best every day.
thirty_sec: Gallup asked 198,000 employees one question: do you get to do what you do best every day? Those who strongly agreed were more likely to work in business units with lower turnover, higher productivity and happier customers, though that is an association, not proof of cause. Then Gallup asked more than 1.7 million employees. In the large organizations surveyed, only 20 percent strongly agreed.
